svg.aria-label: Animated story: a big teacher model explores a tree of ideas, a linearizer squashes it into one story, and a tiny student model learns to solve the puzzle in one pass.

g.text: Teaching a tiny model to think like a tree
Tree-of-Thoughts distillation on the Game of 24
1. Gemma looped, so DeepSeek became the teacher. It tries many paths, checking moves with code.
2. Dead ends go into memory, so it never wastes time on them again.
3. The linearizer squashes the tree into ONE story: try, fail, backtrack, win.
4. The tiny student reads thousands of these stories and learns to backtrack.
5. At test time: one pass, no tree search needed.
